fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: A dropped weight on a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Dented Ripple
fusions.desc: Rings out in a circle, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 50% chance to be [Sundered] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unflinching Shell
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 30 damage and raises your armour by 10%, both for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Composure
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 15%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
